d605.note: D-605 promoted authority; the board D-606's relief run was proposed on

head.note: D-607 promoted authority; the board D-607's R129.1 run was proposed on

findings: THE CENTRE-IN-COPPER CONTRACT IS THE CALIBRATED ONE.  Six of the seven promoted barrels sit at 0.0000 mm from their net's body copper -- their centres are INSIDE it -- and D-607's refused R129.1 barrel is 4 mm or more from any +3V3 body copper.  Eroding by the barrel's own radius is WRONG and is not used: it refuses C5.1 and U17.5, both promoted copper that closed an edge.  A via whose ring pokes microns past a pour edge is bonded by the refill.

THE ONE EXCEPTION IS NOT A FALSE POSITIVE, IT IS A COALITION.  C7.1's promoted barrel at (60.3, 71.0) lay 1.3524 mm from ANY filled +3V3 island on the board it was proposed on, and closed its edge anyway.  The mechanism is measured, not guessed: on the promoted board an In3 +3V3 island of 7.876 mm2 contains EXACTLY TWO items -- C7.1's barrel and C5.1's, both laid by the SAME D-606 transaction -- and every +3V3 zone on this board is filled with island-removal mode 0, ALWAYS REMOVE.  That island held no net item before the run, so every previous fill deleted it; two barrels landing in it resurrected it; and C5.1's barrel lands 0.0000 mm inside the body's own F.Cu copper.  C7.1 was bonded THROUGH C5.1, not by its own barrel.  +3V3 owns no B.Cu pour at all, so the 0.825 mm escape run cannot be the path.

SO THE PREDICATE IS A CERTIFICATE, NEVER A VETO.  Every barrel it admits lands in body copper that exists BEFORE the refill, and a refill only grows a zone towards new copper of its own net, so an admitted barrel bonds.  What it cannot see is a coalition: two barrels that bond only because they resurrect a deleted island together.  A land it refuses is not thereby proved unreachable.
IT WOULD HAVE SAVED FOUR GATE RUNS ALREADY.  D-604 spent three on SW9.2 at every rung for 69 -> 69 each and D-607 spent one on R129.1 for 59 -> 59; the predicate refuses both by name.
method: read-only.  Every barrel this board has already promoted through maze3d.stitch_pad, re-tested on the board it was PROPOSED on -- the seven D-606 escape-relief stitches on D-605's promoted authority 3952597e..., and D-607's refused R129.1 barrel on the promoted cfd10db1... .  `raw` is the via CENTRE inside KiCad's own filled polygon for an island owned by the body cluster, on ANY copper layer; `eroded` additionally demands the barrel's own radius plus one lattice cell of margin.  `nearest_body_copper_mm` is a binary search on SHAPE_POLY_SET.Collide.
question: does a site inside the BODY cluster's own filled pour predict that KiCad's refill will BOND a stitch barrel -- and is the prediction sound in both directions?
